configuration.data:
kind: AdaptiveDialog
beginDialog:
  kind: OnActivity
  id: main
  condition: =!IsBlank(System.Activity.ChannelData.DVRecordContext)
  priority: 0
  actions:
    - kind: ParseValue
      id: AWiNoW
      variable: Global.PA_Copilot_DVRecordContext_Version
      valueType: String
      value: =If(!IsBlank(System.Activity.ChannelData.DVRecordContext_Version), Text(System.Activity.ChannelData.DVRecordContext_Version), "-1")

    - kind: ParseValue
      id: UQYja7
      variable: Global.PA_Copilot_DVRecordContext
      valueType:
        kind: Table
        properties:
          EntityName: String
          RecordId: String
          SpanValue: String

      value: =Text(System.Activity.ChannelData.DVRecordContext)
configuration.description: Triggered on Message received to pull the record context picked from the context picker relevant to the user utterance
configuration.name: DV Record Context - Activity Trigger
